about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: About 26i Engineering Consultations
about.p1: We are a leading company in the field of engineering consultations, always striving to provide innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the aspirations of our clients. We combine deep-rooted experience with the latest technologies to ensure the success of every project we undertake.
about.p2: The company was founded on the principles of quality, accuracy, and transparency, making us a trusted partner for many individuals, companies, and real estate developers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
about.visionDesc: To be the first choice in providing integrated engineering consultations and to contribute to the renaissance and development of the urban sector with global standards.
about.missionDesc: Providing high-quality engineering services through a professional and passionate team, to build sustainable trust with all our clients.
